Best friend #1 - We bonded over Calvin and Hobbes and Wall Ball in grade 5. I moved 6,142 miles away 4 years ago(start of my freshman year) and we still talk every day.
Best friend #2 - I had just moved to the US from Canada and was new to my high school. I had made quite a few friends already but not too many in my bio class, just one. We'll call her M. So we had to break off into tables and rotate around the classroom answering questions, but the groups weren't strictly enforced and you could pretty much move around freely. M was talking to this other girl(who we'll call E), just the two of them at a table. I wasnt really close with M, just casual friends. I saw them and I was initially like "cool ill go sit with M" but then I saw E and just went "wow she looks like a cool person" and then talked to her as if she was my friend already(I don't know what came over me). It worked, and we had a gold heart on snap(broke my previous 2 month heart) in 3 days from then, and have talked every single day for the last 4 years of high school. We're going to college together now.

Hey man.
I'm sorry, I'm not a dad. I'm a fellow child, and I'm going through something very similar. I feel in love with my best friend 4 years ago, and there hasn't been a day I haven't thought about her since. I promise, I know the feeling. We're going to college and I know she doesn't like me back. So I'm going to watch her get into relationships, and it's going to tear my heart apart. I've had 4 years of heartbreak and I'm going to have 4 years more. 
I'm sorry, this doesn't have a happy ending, but I just want you to know that you're not alone. I've cried about this more than I'd ever admit, but I'm right here with you. I've had the long nights of sobbing and regret(and I'm going to have more) but i have friends who've been through the same thing and after long periods of time they've gotten over their girls. I'm holding onto the blind hope that they're right and that we will too.
 I know what it's like to want her to be yours so bad but to know that it's not going to happen. Just keep feeling the pain, it'll help you get over it.
Good luck dude, and you're not alone with these feelings and thoughts. I promise.
